column1: # Drinks no government table has (reviewed 2026-10-21): each line becomes one generic food whose values are the
# median of the Open Food Facts labels in those categories (tool/catalog/readers/off_drinks.py, ODbL), at least 5
# products, every nutrient from the labels that give it. Left out on purpose: OFF's rooibos, matcha and yerba mate
# are the dry leaves (per 100 g of tea, not of the drink: aliases to herbal tea instead, defaults.tsv), and its
# "compotes to drink" are fruit purée pouches, not uzvar. Prosecco, cava, porter, ryazhenka, limoncello, absinthe, raki
# and Aperol spritz have under 5 labels with values (EU alcohol labels need none): aliases in defaults.tsv instead.
# Serving: the usual container, in grams (≈ ml): a can 330, a bottle 500, a glass 250; alcohol as NIAAA's standard
